svg.title: The $675,000 Base Revenue-to-Net Bridge
svg.desc: diagram id: diag-03-base-revenue-to-owner-net; chart type: waterfall; title: The $675,000 Base Revenue-to-Net Bridge; subtitle: Four expense deductions leave $202,500, exactly 30.0% of revenue.; chapter number: 3; epistemic tag: illustrative_model; assumptions note: USD annual amounts. The first and final bars are absolute totals; the four intervening bars are signed expense changes. Expense categories are illustrative allocations, not supplied scorecard line items. Canonical Base costs total $472,500, or $39,375 per month, so the supplied $4,000–$20,000 monthly opex range cannot describe fully loaded Base expenses. This illustration assigns $5,625 monthly to operating overhead and separately budgets payroll, contractors, and direct delivery; that classification is an explicit modeling assumption.; caption: $675,000 − $180,000 − $135,000 − $90,000 − $67,500 = $202,500. Canonical annual revenue, margin, and owner net: Conservative $150,000 / 20% / $30,000; Base $675,000 / 30.0% / $202,500; Scaled $1,200,000 / 40% / $480,000. Conservative and Base use five people; Scaled uses seven.; stages: label: Recognized operator revenue; value: $675,000 earned from retainers and accepted-opportunity fees.; numeric value: 675000.0; detail: Opening absolute total: $540,000 of earned retainers plus $135,000 of accepted-opportunity fees. Exclude client contract values and unearned customer deposits.; label: Full-time personnel; value: Subtract $180,000 for the two full-time operator seats.; numeric value: -180000.0; detail: Illustrative loaded annual personnel budget for the operator lead and account director, including budgeted founder pay where applicable. Running balance: $495,000.; label: Contract specialist delivery; value: Subtract $135,000 for three contracted specialist seats.; numeric value: -135000.0; detail: Allocate contracted research, campaign production, and CRM operations costs to the core pod. Contract scope and worker classification require separate review. Running balance: $360,000.; label: Direct campaign delivery; value: Subtract $90,000 for operator-funded campaign delivery inputs.; numeric value: -90000.0; detail: Budget incremental campaign data, client-specific production, and other direct delivery inputs without duplicating contractor costs. Client-funded pass-through spend is excluded from this illustration. Running balance: $270,000.; label: Operating overhead; value: Subtract $67,500 for shared operating and administrative costs.; numeric value: -67500.0; detail: Budget shared CRM subscriptions, accounting, insurance, security administration, and payment processing separately from direct campaign inputs. Monthly equivalent: $5,625. Running balance: $202,500.; label: Annual owner net profit; value: $202,500 remaining equals the canonical 30.0% Base margin.; numeric value: 202500.0; detail: Closing absolute total, not another positive cash-flow increment. Divide $202,500 by $675,000 to obtain 30.0%; do not add budgeted founder pay back into this metric.

circle.title: label: Recognized operator revenue; value: $675,000 earned from retainers and accepted-opportunity fees.; numeric value: 675000.0; detail: Opening absolute total: $540,000 of earned retainers plus $135,000 of accepted-opportunity fees. Exclude client contract values and unearned customer deposits.

label: Full-time personnel; value: Subtract $180,000 for the two full-time operator seats.; numeric value: -180000.0; detail: Illustrative loaded annual personnel budget for the operator lead and account director, including budgeted founder pay where applicable. Running balance: $495,000.

label: Contract specialist delivery; value: Subtract $135,000 for three contracted specialist seats.; numeric value: -135000.0; detail: Allocate contracted research, campaign production, and CRM operations costs to the core pod. Contract scope and worker classification require separate review. Running balance: $360,000.

label: Direct campaign delivery; value: Subtract $90,000 for operator-funded campaign delivery inputs.; numeric value: -90000.0; detail: Budget incremental campaign data, client-specific production, and other direct delivery inputs without duplicating contractor costs. Client-funded pass-through spend is excluded from this illustration. Running balance: $270,000.

label: Operating overhead; value: Subtract $67,500 for shared operating and administrative costs.; numeric value: -67500.0; detail: Budget shared CRM subscriptions, accounting, insurance, security administration, and payment processing separately from direct campaign inputs. Monthly equivalent: $5,625. Running balance: $202,500.

label: Annual owner net profit; value: $202,500 remaining equals the canonical 30.0% Base margin.; numeric value: 202500.0; detail: Closing absolute total, not another positive cash-flow increment. Divide $202,500 by $675,000 to obtain 30.0%; do not add budgeted founder pay back into this metric.

text.title: Assumptions: USD annual amounts. The first and final bars are absolute totals; the four intervening bars are signed expense changes. Expense categories are illustrative allocations, not supplied scorecard line items. Canonical Base costs total $472,500, or $39,375 per month, so the supplied $4,000–$20,000 monthly opex range cannot describe fully loaded Base expenses. This illustration assigns $5,625 monthly to operating overhead and separately budgets payroll, contractors, and direct delivery; that classification is an explicit modeling assumption.
